title: OmopStandardEvent
description: Standardized Healthcare Event conforming to OHDSI OMOP Common Data Model

person_source_value.description: Unique Patient Identifier / Medical Record Number (MRN)

source_name.description: Source System Feed (e.g. EHR Vitals, LIS Lab, Pharmacy, EHR Diagnoses)

source_vocabulary.description: Originating Medical Terminology (LOINC, NDC, ICD10CM, LEGACY_LAB_LOCAL)

value_num.description: Numeric representation of the observed value for quantitative metrics

unit.description: Measurement unit (e.g. mmHg, bpm, mmol/L, mg/dL)

event_time.description: Event timestamp in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

domain_id.description: OMOP CDM Domain (Measurement, Condition, Drug, Observation)
